searchText: Opened an issue for c-kzg about making it easier to compile with both minimal & mainnet configurations: <https://github.com/ethereum/c-kzg-4844/issues/312> This may ease some pains with enabling minimal specs in clients. It would certainly help Lighthouse, where we usually compile binaries and tests to support minimal & mainnet
